title: Nutrition and the Cycle
content: Dietary needs can fluctuate with the menstrual cycle. During menstruation, iron-rich foods (like leafy greens and lean meats) help replenish iron lost through bleeding. In the luteal phase (before a period), magnesium-rich foods (like dark chocolate, nuts, and seeds) may help reduce cramping and improve mood. Staying hydrated is important throughout the cycle to minimize bloating.
